newsVersionExact: Anthropic is merging Claude chat and Cowork into one gradually rolled-out conversation experience.
actualMeaningExact: A person no longer has to pick a simple chat or longer-work mode before starting.
mechanismExact: The same conversation can answer briefly or take several steps and use tools; its permission mode controls when Claude asks before actions.
familiarExampleExact: Attach three appliance manuals and request an editable maintenance checklist, then check dates and safety instructions against the originals.

jargon.plainMeaning: a job that takes several actions instead of one answer
Claude asks before it takes actions

learningConnections.concept: Set an authority line before delegating
learningConnections.learningPayoff: Name what the agent may do, when it must ask and when it must stop.
